_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج قائمة المعالم (Milestones) هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

Milestone name.guidance: Milestone name that uniquely defines the milestone

Milestone description.guidance: A description of the milestone in enough detail to understand what is needed to determine the milestone is complete

Type.guidance: A description of the type of milestone, such as • Internal or external • Interim or final • Mandatory or optional
